instrument: xml insert hook — one file, the analyzer's edges beside every row the store was asked to write

reading.(a)_insertedTwice: insertedMoreOftenThanAnalyzerEmitted is non-empty: one analyzer edge is written more than once with different source bindings
reading.(b)_poolEmitsMore: onlyInserted is non-empty: the indexer received edges a direct parseFile does not produce — a fleet-level finding about the pool path
reading.neither: the multisets agree; then the 1.83x must come from a path this hook does not see (e.g. a second indexing pass) and brainFileInserts is the next thing to read
